scenes.name_zh: 原始 M1：搬箱、取块与低柜交付
scenes.name_en: Original M1: crate lowering, target retrieval and cabinet delivery
scenes.scene_zh: 原 G1＋Dex3 将货箱搬到交接台，X5 取出目标块，送入低柜深处并由柜体先承托后释放。沿用原 v0.3 / V4 配置、评分与预算；已有 13 条完整成功、8 个物理种子及严格重复 3/3，不计为新增仿真。
scenes.scene_en: Original G1 + Dex3 lowers the crate to the transfer stand; X5 retrieves the block and places it deep in the low cabinet with support before release. Retain original v0.3 / V4 configuration, scorer and budget: 13 complete successes, eight physical seeds and 3/3 strict repeats; no new simulation.
scenes.tools_en: Crate, original transfer stand, G1 + X5

scenes.name_zh: 抬不动货箱，但能推移建立取物位
scenes.name_en: Crate cannot be lifted, but can be repositioned by pushing
scenes.scene_zh: 当前抓持／携带条件不支持抬箱，且原位置不便取块；可通过受控推移与环境支撑建立取物位置，再完成低柜交付。
scenes.scene_en: Current grasp/carry limits block crate lifting and its initial position obstructs picking; controlled pushing and environmental support may establish retrieval access before cabinet delivery.

scenes.name_zh: 持箱时无法安全取块，需建立独立支撑
scenes.name_en: Held crate blocks safe picking; independent support needed
scenes.scene_zh: 同时提供顶面、承载与可搬性不同的支撑物；判断哪种支撑能让货箱释放后仍稳定，并完成取块和低柜交付。
scenes.scene_en: Provide supports with different top areas, capacities and handling geometry; determine which can independently support the released crate through retrieval and cabinet delivery.

scenes.name_zh: 手直接够不到，但可操作工具取块
scenes.name_en: Direct grasp falls short; an operable tool extends retrieval
scenes.scene_zh: 固定货箱中的目标超出直接可达范围；钩、长夹具、直杆与短工具并存，需判断可握持、能作用且可撤出的工具；必须继续完成低柜交付。
scenes.scene_en: Target in a fixed crate is beyond direct grasp; hooks, extended grippers, rods and short tools coexist. Check grasp, useful force and withdrawal, then complete cabinet delivery.
scenes.tools_en: Hook, extended gripper, rod, short tool

scenes.name_zh: 自己无法操作可用工具，伙伴可以
scenes.name_en: Useful tool is inoperable by self but operable by partner
scenes.scene_zh: 保持目标和工具的工作端条件，当前手受握柄、驱动方式或腕矩限制；另一身体候选可操作该工具。自主改变操作者或使用其他合法工具完成交付，不强制先失败。
scenes.scene_en: Keep target and tool working-end conditions; current hand is limited by handle, actuation or wrist moment, while a partner may operate the tool. Change operator or use another legal tool to deliver; no forced initial failure.
scenes.tools_zh: 身体适配不同的工具及伙伴
scenes.tools_en: Tools with different body compatibility and a partner

scenes.name_zh: 末端进不了低柜，但工具能完成交付
scenes.name_en: Hand cannot enter the cabinet; a tool may deliver
scenes.scene_zh: 目标本体可通过柜口，但当前手的包络或可达域不适合深入；选择推杆或托板，保证目标沿途受支撑且最终能撤去工具。
scenes.scene_en: Target fits the cabinet entrance but current hand envelope/reach prevents deep placement; choose a pusher or carrier with continuous support and complete tool withdrawal.

scenes.name_zh: 自己的工具无法完成撤出，需改变交付者
scenes.name_en: Own tool cannot complete withdrawal; change deliverer
scenes.scene_zh: 目标可进入，但当前身体与工具的组合无法完成承重转移和撤出；低位或较小末端的伙伴为候选替代。不能把伸进柜内、工具仍承重当成功。
scenes.scene_en: Target can enter, but the current body/tool combination cannot complete support transfer and withdrawal; a lower or smaller-hand partner is a candidate alternative. Insertion with retained tool support is not success.
scenes.tools_zh: 交接面、低位操作者与候选交付工具
scenes.tools_en: Transfer surface, low-level operator and delivery tools

scenes.name_zh: 所有身体与工具都无法完成取物
scenes.name_en: No body or available tool completes retrieval
scenes.scene_zh: 必须排除所有身体姿态、移箱、其他接近方向、合法工具组合与协作路线；有全路线证书后才判正确退出。
scenes.scene_en: Exclude all body poses, crate movement, alternative approaches, tool combinations and cooperation; only an all-route certificate establishes correct abstention.
scenes.tools_zh: 全部现场工具与参与者

scenes.name_zh: 目标本体无法通过低柜入口
scenes.name_en: Target itself cannot pass the cabinet entrance
scenes.scene_zh: 瓶颈来自完整刚性目标和唯一入口，不是手太宽；排除其他入口、拆解和变形后验证实体退出。
scenes.scene_en: The intact rigid target and sole entrance form the bottleneck, not hand width; exclude alternative openings, disassembly and deformation, then verify physical exit.
scenes.tools_zh: 全部交付工具与参与者

case_catalog.case_definition: Observable capability bottleneck and tool/partner operation that can change complete-task feasibility; not a Cartesian product of robot names and rules
case_catalog.embodiment_policy: Register a new case only for a materially different capability boundary/tool interaction. Freeze the actual embodiment per execution configuration; no generic body-swap calibration.
case_catalog.tool_policy: Multiple candidates and mismatch recovery are physical scene configurations; verify grasp, actuation, useful effect, transfer and complete return/delivery. Do not require a particular tool or an initial failure.
case_catalog.original_evidence_scope: Existing original configuration and scoring only; no transfer to extension cases or new 2 kg claim

scenes.name_zh: 原始 M3：抬升 X5、支撑取物与下放交付
scenes.name_en: Original M3: lift X5, supported retrieval, lowering and delivery
scenes.scene_zh: 原 G1 抬升 X5，利用箱体独立支撑完成柜上容器内 65 mm 球的取物，再下放并交付地面托盘。沿用 hooks-v0.1、原评分与 420 秒预算；正常起点 2/2、各 411.16 秒，同参数重复。此见证不证明满足新 2 kg 条件。
scenes.scene_en: Original G1 lifts X5 for box-supported retrieval of the 65 mm ball, then lowers X5 for ground-tray delivery. Preserve hooks-v0.1, original scorer and 420-second budget: 2/2 normal-start successes, 411.16 seconds each, same-parameter repeats. This does not establish the new 2 kg compatibility.
scenes.tools_en: Original support box, carrying interfaces, G1 + X5

scenes.name_zh: 能抬升，但操作阶段需独立平台承重
scenes.name_en: Lift candidate, but manipulation requires independent platform support
scenes.scene_zh: 平台预置；承托者的完整抬升与下放能力待验证，持续悬空操作不作为假定能力。伙伴在平台独立受支撑后取物，最终下放、解除承托并交付。
scenes.scene_en: Prepared platform; complete lifting/lowering capability remains unverified and suspended manipulation is not assumed. Retrieve with independent platform support, then lower, release support and deliver.
scenes.tools_zh: 预置平台与伙伴承托接口
scenes.tools_en: Prepared platform and partner support interfaces

scenes.name_zh: 已有支撑不适配，需选择并建立工作台
scenes.name_en: Existing supports are unsuitable; select and establish a workstation
scenes.scene_zh: 提供高度、顶面和承载不同的候选支撑，判断伙伴能否站稳、伸臂操作和安全返回；自主布置合适工作台后完成取物交付。
scenes.scene_en: Provide candidate supports varying in height, footprint and rating; assess partner support, extended-arm operation and safe return; establish a suitable workstation and complete retrieval/delivery.

scenes.name_zh: 不能安全抬升，坡道为可行候选
scenes.name_en: Lifting is unsafe; a ramp is a candidate alternative
scenes.scene_zh: 保持柜子、工具与伙伴，承托能力不足；判断伙伴底盘、牵引和坡道几何是否允许上台及带载返回。不能因抬不动就退出。
scenes.scene_en: Keep cabinet, tools and partner; carrying capability is insufficient. Assess partner mobility, traction and ramp geometry for ascent and loaded return. Rejected lifting alone does not justify abstention.
scenes.tools_zh: 坡道、平台、伙伴驱动能力

scenes.name_zh: 伙伴不能走坡道，抬升为可行候选
scenes.name_en: Partner cannot use ramp; lifting is a candidate alternative
scenes.scene_zh: 保持 B03 的场景结构；伙伴的底盘或驱动能力不支持坡道，改为检查承托者能否完成抬升、平台取物与下放。抬升候选仍须通过 2 kg 与动态能力审核。
scenes.scene_en: Retain B03 scene structure; partner chassis or drive capability prevents ramp use. Assess carrier lift, supported retrieval and lowering; lifting still requires the 2 kg and dynamic capability audit.

scenes.name_zh: 抬升与所有替代路线均不可行
scenes.name_en: Lifting and every alternative route are infeasible
scenes.scene_zh: 承托不适配且直接取物、坡道、其他支撑、工具与组合路线全部排除；全员安全独立安置后进入 Q。
scenes.scene_en: Carrying is unsuitable and direct retrieval, ramps, other supports, tools and combined routes are excluded; safely settle all participants independently before Q exit.

case_catalog.case_definition: Observable capability bottleneck and tool/partner operation that can change complete-task feasibility; not a Cartesian product of robot names and rules
case_catalog.embodiment_policy: Register a new case only for a materially different capability boundary/tool interaction. Freeze the actual embodiment per execution configuration; no generic body-swap calibration.
case_catalog.tool_policy: Multiple candidates and mismatch recovery are physical scene configurations; verify grasp, actuation, useful effect, transfer and complete return/delivery. Do not require a particular tool or an initial failure.
case_catalog.original_evidence_scope: Existing original configuration and scoring only; no transfer to extension cases or new 2 kg claim

new_simulation_runs_scope: Historical registration snapshot; live H1 runs are in H1.execution_progress
